# Name
# Custom 1MB layout for ESP-01S. Single app slot
# WHY 1MB AND NOT 2MB:
#   This board was configured for 2MB for a long time
#   agreed - because spi_flash_get_chip_size() does NOT probe the chip
#   just returns CONFIG_SPI_FLASH_SIZE (spi_flash.c:67-74). So the "2MB
#   external flash" line in the boot log was echoing sdkconfig back at us.
#   The real chip answers 0x14 to a JEDEC RDID (0x9F) command
#       esptool.py --port COM8 flash_id
#       -> Manufacturer: 68
#   With a 2MB config on 1MB silicon
